scene: The glass elevator brings you into the buzzing Central Transit Spire.
picture: A flat side-scrolling cross section of the Transit Spire along one level floor. On the far left, a pink bullet train sits open at its gate. The player stands left of centre, facing right in her red bomber jacket and roller skates. Right of centre docks a solar-sail junk, and far right waits a yellow weather balloon.
shown: a sleek pink bullet train idling with open doors on the far left platform
a wooden solar junk ship moored at an open dock right of centre
a tethered yellow weather balloon basket ready for boarding on the far right
